comparison.objective: Dry-fit a slip coupling across an open drain-pipe repair joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually lift a sagging pipe into coaxial alignment while sliding a close-clearance coupling.
comparison.success_condition: Both joints aligned within 1.5 mm and 1 degree, insertion depths met and centered, then released still for one second.
comparison.reason: It shares coaxial alignment, but tests sustained support during close-clearance sleeve insertion. The candidate tests mandrel stabilization during impact, controlled notch fracture and complete tang recovery.
